evidence: WRK-MCP-WIDGET PIC X(64) - MCP widget references

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) point master settings screen (Z03) for the JMA ORCA medical billing system. Handles diagnosis/treatment point master configuration.
purpose.summary: This program implements the point master (tensuu master) settings screen (Z03) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It manages configuration of medical procedure point values, validity dates, treatment classification codes, and various medical billing parameters. It is a batch/online screen program handling input validation and master data registration for Japanese medical insurance billing.

notable_features: 37 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
Large screen-item ordering table (TBL-GMN-JUN) with 109 entries
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Widget/MCP references suggesting GUI front-end integration
REDEFINES with OCCURS INDEXED for screen field table
Fixed format with max line length 74
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 4474 lines / ~200KB.
